notes.title: Discover the Terrible Truth Behind the Wyrmwood Incident.
notes.content:
Happy Halloween from Grindwheel Games!

With wooden items twisting into horrible forms, the UIC faces a terrible calamity unless YOU can discover what is causing this new horror.  Battle from the midnight streets of the Capital to the muddy depths of Hag Mere in the eighth foray into the dark, Lovecraftian fantasy world of The Hunter's Journals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45104889/b1d55b9f0283f08a4ce361dd65cb0d485fca8bb7.jpg[/img]

We hope you have enjoyed the art releases so far, and if you want to see more, please don't forget our merchandise stall over on TeePublic.

https://www.teepublic.com/user/grindwheel-games-store

notes.title: Return to the ash-choked streets of Wight Chapel.
notes.content:
Its time to go back, hunter.

The madness of Pattic Claine is not finished with you yet.  Five missing Galvanic horrors await you in the ash-clogged lanes and crematoria of Wight Chapel.  Conclude the mystery in Grindwheel Games' first two-part adventure.  Can you face the nightmare once again and escape with your sanity intact?

Happy Halloween!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35938961/df69fd838f1914759430a9fdde532656515a9922.jpg[/img]

And, should you like any of the artwork from the new book, don't forget to check out our store on Teepublic, when you can find wall art, buttons, magnets, wall hangings and more.  This includes the cover art for Return to Wight Chapel, which has been added to the store today.

https://www.teepublic.com/user/grindwheel-games-store

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 6
notes.content:
And here it is - a page image that will come up time and again!  The death image for Return to Wight Chapel is our final reveal.  Now all you have to wait for is Halloween to get your hands on the game itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44557069/dceb2c339dd6772ef3c51d7c3b6e1309baf02626.jpg[/img]

If there is one good thing about dying in Wight Chapel, it is that you do not have far to get to the closest crematoria.  Of course, this assumed you stay dead, which one would hope for given the alternative.  There have been reports of hunters rising from the grave before, and it never ends well.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 5
notes.content:
Only one page left.  We have seen the heroes who have come to bring the district of Wight Chapel to heel, but what of their foes?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44557069/5abedb394c248c496c027712584a77f7e4e7f3ea.jpg[/img]

The final tally of missing Galvanics was five.  All of them were from Pattic Claine's insane 'Broadsheet Killer Rehabilitation Program', meaning they had the minds of lunatics locked in bodies of iron, brass and bone.  But, was there some greater force at play here?  Only the hunter assigned to the case would be able to reveal this.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 4
notes.content:
Just a little over a week to go until Return to Wight Chapel hits the digital shelves.  Here are the heroes of the piece, ready to hunt down the missing Galvanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44557069/13766e55ee75c6c445730347b3e462e1ff3e6605.jpg[/img]

The team of archivists and hunters assigned to mop up the missing Galvanics have had their names and identities withheld for legal reasons.  It can be assumed they are amongst the best available given the importance of the case.  The above is an artists impression of them at work, as the matter was far too serious for them to take frivolous pauses to be photographed or sketched.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 3
notes.content:
We have just 3 images to go before Return to Wight Chapel is released.  Here is the third general image and story to get everyone in the mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44557069/ad723790ceccd16bfa9141f077d099962915c0e9.jpg[/img]

One of the few mass-produced magical items in the UIC, Spirit String comes in spindles of varying sizes.  It can be used for a number of purposes, with the most common being placing it across all the doors in a new house overnight.  If any of the string breaks or loses its vibrant red colour in the morning, that shows the owners that there is a ghost or other spirit present.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 2
notes.content:
The countdown continues with our next general art page.  Also some news that we have the final character voice plugged in and ready to go.  Get ready for a Halloween to remember!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44557069/17c8b28e71afe76c4e1aec416279a361af0694cb.jpg[/img]

Ink is one of the primary methods of creating magical runes.  In secular circles it can be enhanced with ingredients such as corpse ash and powdered bone, although this is considered illegal outside the halls of academia.  Blessed ink is created through prayer to wholesome deities, while this particular example was empowered through more malevolent means.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 1
notes.content:
As is tradition, we are beginning our countdown to the release of Return to Wight Chapel with the general art pages.  Please find the first below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44557069/bd45ff19c32642f617399c9a7e1c0a0f0fe9e894.jpg[/img]

While some hunts happen almost spontaneously, it is normally the case that a significant amount of legwork will be involved before one is launched.  In the case of The Crawling Horror and its aftermath there were literally crates of documents to be sorted, read and cross referenced in order to make sure things were finally settled.  It was this attention to detail which led to the discovery of the runaway Galvanics in the first place.
